summary: NISCH-010 Predictive Risk Engine (Phase 1) Backend Verification Complete. All 39 unit tests pass (30 risk_prediction + 9 swallow_audit). Migration en1a2b3c4ea01 applied (head). risk_predictions table verified with all 19 columns including prediction_class, prediction_context_snapshot, prediction_pipeline_version, outcome_resolution_version. All 4 indexes verified (idx_rp_subject, idx_rp_zone, idx_rp_accuracy, idx_rp_pending_outcome). Scheduler running with 24 jobs including risk_prediction_prewarm (1h cadence) and risk_prediction_reconciler (15-min cadence). All 4 API endpoints verified: /api/risk/predict (200 deferred shape), /api/risk/zones/{zone_id}/forecast (200 deferred), /api/risk/predictions/{subject_id}/accuracy (200 with reconciled_n=0), /api/risk/route (501 Phase 2 stub). Alert-pipeline integration confirmed non-blocking (predict() wrapped in try/except, does NOT propagate exceptions).
critical_code_review_comments: NISCH-010 migration en1a2b3c4ea01: Creates risk_predictions table with 19 columns. Immutable ledger design - only reconciliation columns (actual_outcome, delta, outcome_recorded_at, outcome_resolution_version) are updated post-creation.
NISCH-010 forecasters.py: EWMA (alpha=0.3), BayesianTrendScorer (epsilon=0.01), ProphetForecaster (soft-dep stub). blend_forecasts() uses confidence-weighted averaging, skips zero-confidence votes.

NISCH-010 predictor.py: classify_prediction() priority order locked: critical_escalation > volatile > rising > stable. Thresholds: CRITICAL_RISK_THRESHOLD=0.75, HIGH_VOLATILITY_THRESHOLD=0.15, RISING_SLOPE_THRESHOLD=0.02.
NISCH-010 reconciler.py: compute_outcome() coefficients locked: 0.35*severity + 0.20*escalation/3 + 0.20*ack_rate + 0.15*density/5 + 0.10*dispatch. Output clamped to [0,1].
NISCH-010 prewarmer.py: RiskPredictionPrewarmer subclass with scheduler_job_id='risk_prediction_prewarm', jitter_base_s=3600 (1h), cache_ttl_s=3600.
NISCH-010 reconciler_scheduler.py: RECONCILE_INTERVAL_S=900 (15 min), RECONCILE_BATCH_SIZE=200, job_id='risk_prediction_reconciler'.
NISCH-010 safety_incident_engine.py lines 133-168: Predictive risk modifier wrapped in try/except, logs warning on failure, NEVER propagates exception. Non-blocking guarantee confirmed.
NISCH-010 scheduler_runner.py: Both risk_prediction_prewarm and risk_prediction_reconciler registered. Boot log shows 24 schedulers started.

NISCH-010 swallow_audit.py: Two new entries added for predictor.py:266 and reconciler.py:216 with category=compensating_action_exists. Debt map: idempotency_race=1, compensating_action_exists=38, unresolved_debt=1.
